verdict.rationale: Unleash has automations in the form of release templates and automated milestone progression with metric-triggered safeguards. Change requests add an approval step before changes reach an environment, which covers review. Rollback is only implied: safeguards can pause rollouts or disable environments, and flags can be killed without redeploys, but nothing shows reverting an automation's own definition. Missing for 10: versioning or change history of automation definitions, explicit rollback of release plans or templates to a prior version, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
